uplink.description: Periodic uplink (fPort 4): box temperature + humidity -> climate; both digital inputs clear
uplink._note: Upstream-example input (TTN strega smart-valve codec yaml, Apache-2.0). expected.data via the ported upstream decoder (oracle: Temp 23.96 C, Hygro 46.82 %, DI0 "0", DI1 "0"). Temp->air.temperature, Hygro->air.relativeHumidity (climate); Bat->batteryPercent; Power->powerState; valve/leak/fraud/tamper status as top-level camelCase extras; DI_0/DI_1 -> channels[] entries di0/di1, each carrying the raw status bit as the unsuffixed extra `di` (polarity is undocumented upstream - see codec header).

uplink.description: Periodic uplink (fPort 4): digital inputs differ - DI_0 set (di0 "1"), DI_1 clear (di1 "0")
uplink._note: Same frame with byte 4 changed 0x32->0x3A, which sets DI_0 and leaves DI_1 clear (oracle: reference/upstream-codec.js returns DI0 "1", DI1 "0", every other field unchanged). Exercises per-position truth: a transposed di0/di1 mapping would fail this vector. All other status bits (Tamper "1", vt "10") and the temperature/humidity/battery fields are identical to the upstream example above.
